hints.title: Order Price Mapping
hints.text: Maintain a lookup table mapping order_id to price, and a running total sum.

hints.title: Dynamic Updates
hints.text: When adding an order, add price to total. When cancelling an order, deduct price from total.

hints.title: Constant Time Value Query
hints.text: Return the running total in O(1) time.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Here n is the number of active orders.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Summing order values on each query takes O(n) per call.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Running sum achieves O(1) query time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Expects clean hash map and running total accumulator.
